_comment: T1 CHAIN-PIN AUDIT rung (docs/SPEC_synthetic_minimum_network.md §14 T1 (measured record §12.8.1)) — eq34 re-run
with the two confounds cleared and the pin pipeline COUNTED.
Rungs 2/6 armed the Eq-34 chain datum and still emitted 0/19, which reads as
'the datum is not the lever'.  But that reading rested on the ABSENCE of a
complaint, and the pin pipeline has three silent loss stages: the election
declares Σ(n_c+m_c) pins per (constellation,signal); foldAmb/foldRpb
early-return without a trace when the elected ambiguity/RPB has no state or
no live phase row; and a station whose local block the PD guard rejects is
dropped WITH every folded pin it carried.  Standing invariant #4: an armed
datum that places fewer pins than it thinks reads exactly like a working one.
This rung arms the new eq34 pin-audit counters (always-on under eq34) plus
network.station_pd_pin_aware — the loader RECOMMENDS it with eq34 (hub
stations carry many 1e10 ambiguity pins and skew the plain median-|pivot| PD
floor) and rungs 2/6 lacked it.  Decision point from the handoff: if the
L2W group lands short of (n_c+m_c), the chain is incomplete and fixing it is
the correct cure for the n-invariant L2W near-null — no tolerance knob.  If
it lands complete and the gate still withholds, the near-null is elsewhere
and the per-config rank_gate_tol stays.
DEFAULT rank-gate tolerance ON PURPOSE — the withhold is the phenomenon
under audit, and the audit counters accumulate before the gate runs.
